# PHASE-004 - Implement events and snapshot reconciliation

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plan | `PLAN-20260912-3CF9C73F` |
| Phase status | `completed` |
| Depends on | PHASE-002 |
| Canonical revision | 228 |

## Objective

Make deterministic event handling durable, idempotent and quiet before invoking a model.

## Scope

- Queue and cursors
- Local adapters and snapshot ancestry
- Preflight and causal deduplication

## Entry conditions

- Current scope is selected and predecessor active work is reconciled.

## Exit criteria

- Missed/repeated/reordered events converge without duplicate execution or idle model use.

## Risks

- Runtime unavailability must preserve pending delivery; detached volumes must not look like deletion.

## TASK-014 - Implement durable transport and cursors

Store versioned delivery, assessment and operation references under control_records/curator with recoverable atomic publication and canonical Task/receipt links.

| --- | --- |
| Status | `completed` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |

| Design basis | None |

| Dependencies | TASK-009 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | 2026-09-12T22:05:24.439304Z |

### Risks

- Transport durability is separate from cross-system exactly-once execution.

### Acceptance criteria

- Manual corrections survive restart; project/repository/branch/snapshot/causal/policy/source IDs are retained.
- Transport cannot claim Task lifecycle or canonical publication outcomes; cache cleanup cannot erase durable events.

### Planned verification

- Test restart, interrupted append, cursor recovery, duplicated delivery and unknown/corrupt record behavior.

## TASK-016 - Implement branch and snapshot checkpoints

Track observed, assessed, canonically integrated and fully reconciled snapshots separately, using actual Git ancestry and content identity.

| Status | `completed` |
| State reason | None |

| Dependencies | TASK-014, TASK-015 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | 2026-09-12T22:07:19.608163Z |

### Risks

- A branch name alone is not a stable source snapshot.

### Acceptance criteria

- Rebase, squash, force update, rename, deletion and branch switch recompute affected obligations.
- Feature-branch knowledge does not become another branch current; assessment alone never advances reconciliation.

### Planned verification

- Run disposable Git histories covering all ancestry/rename cases and source changes after candidate pass.

## TASK-018 - Implement causal deduplication and stopping

Deduplicate operation deliveries and satisfied effects by identity/source/output hashes while preserving necessary follow-through on Curator repairs. Expose bounded read-only counters from delivery, snapshot and reconciliation-owner evidence for later metric validation.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `completed` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-018, REQ-019, REQ-020, REQ-031, REQ-042 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_causality.py, SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_metrics.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-016, TASK-017 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | 2026-09-12T22:09:01.918812Z |

### Risks

- Do not suppress every Curator-authored commit.

### Acceptance criteria

- Duplicate/retried/out-of-order deliveries produce one logical outcome.
- A code repair still receives documentation/knowledge follow-through; derivative-only follow-up does not restart the repair.
- Unchanged failures/output and selected limits stop expansion with the unresolved finding retained.

### Planned verification

- Exercise self-trigger chains, duplicate learning dispositions, stale retries and repeated unchanged failures.
